source_lines.46: 1.1 By the integration-compatible partition in [F1] and linearity in [F3], subtracting Q_hg cell by cell gives ∫_Ωg−Q_hg=Σ_{j∈J_g}∫_{C_j}(g(y)−g(x_j))dy, using ∫_{C_j}g(x_j)=V_jg(x_j). On a bounding rectangle for each cell, [F3] gives |∫_{C_j}(g−g(x_j))|≤∫_{C_j}|g−g(x_j)|≤V_j osc_{C_j}(g). Summing proves the first inequality. [F1, F3, algebra]
